w: Coordinates, 'build it upwards', 'building under all of the other art' and a letter guideline are directions, which the boundary ruled once counts toward T3-070 (reader A, the larger part); 'Everyone please join the cause!' and 'Calling all hands!' are T3-002 (reader B and my B1).

'WE NEED YOUR HELP IN r/place!' and calls naming where the Time Gear is, which the boundary ruled once counts as calls, lead (T3-002); the template, the new template after the move and the new coordinates are directions (T3-070), as reader A and my B1 have both.

Calls naming where the work is, 'Help us out at r/place! 658, 679', and answers lead (T3-002); starting points, the location answer and the template are directions (T3-070). All three placements hold both themes; reader B put T3-070 first.

'HAIL HYDRA AND AID YOUR FELLOW AGENTS' and calls to build the S.H.I.E.L.D. logo lead (T3-002); the plan's first step, coordinates and finished plan are directions (T3-070); 'Hydra would be cool' and a half-HYDRA half-S.H.I.E.L.D. logo propose the mark (T3-033), as reader B has all three.

'We need more people!' and a call for a concerted effort lead (T3-002, reader A and my B1); asking the mods to 'pick a logo and sticky the plan and coords ... so we all get on the same page' is one plan made official (T3-091, both readers; conflict CC-012), a concept of its own.

The black background first, the first pixel at (953, 11), 'just fill it with color' and where to start the banner are directions, which the boundary ruled once counts toward T3-070 (both readers, the larger part); refusing a bigger Brand, a greatsword for the shared space and correcting the border shading argue the design (T3-004, reader B and my B1).

'It would be easier to do the stem only' proposes a simplified design and the text is positioned, which the boundary ruled once gives to T3-004 (reader B); the pixel art shared is the template (T3-070, reader A and my B1).

The torch starts at (381,318) and moves to 285,512 (T3-020, all three placements); the detailed template with 'the purple most color to the right and the white on the left' posts directions, which the boundary ruled once counts toward T3-070 (reader A); reader B and my B1 read it as the design argued.

Templates, overlays and starting coordinates lead (T3-070, reader B and my B1). Members who took their own side's move for vandalism, 'Sometimes the "vandalism" is actually one of us' (T3-170, my B1), settling the scoreboard time and moving it up three pixels (T3-004, reader A), and further pieces above the scoreboard (T3-041) each have three concepts of their own: four themes, more than three placements carry.

Colours, outlines, box and spacing are argued, 'let's make a white box, with a yellow border', 'four tiles wide ... looks a bit tacky', which the boundary ruled once counts toward T3-004 (reader B and my B1, the larger part); where the 39 begins, the box's corner, a template for cleaners and the H's corner are directions (T3-070, reader A).

Settling the M's size and colours, '20x20 looks kinda bad ... I tried with 40x40', leads (T3-004, reader B and my B1). Choosing and rejecting locations (T3-020), setting the starting grey pixels and starting construction (T3-038), and the pixel map and layout (T3-070, reader A) each have three concepts of their own: four themes, more than three placements carry. Reader B flagged a bag.

Working out Snake's look, the '!' mark, the purple and the settled Ghost Babel aesthetic, leads (T3-004, reader B). Maintenance and clean-up (T3-021, my B1), holding everyone to the agreed design, 'I'll stick religiously to this design' (T3-091, reader A), templates and coordinates (T3-070), and teammates' corrections mistaken for vandalism (T3-170) each have three concepts of their own: more than three placements carry. Reader B flagged a bag.

Correcting and changing the leaf, the 420 and the pineapple leads (T3-004, reader B and my B1). Ents' own mistakes taken for fighting, 'Turns out no one was fighting us at all' (T3-170, my B1), the space settled with the Mona Lisa, 'DON'T GREEN OUT THE LISA' (T3-010), and the new template pushed against the old design (T3-091, reader A) each have three concepts of their own: four themes, more than three placements carry.

Turning the Patriots' 3 into a 0 or an 8, adding 'Final Score' and making ATL red alter another room's mark into the room's own joke (T3-068, my B1), which T3-068's discriminator separates from destroying it; nuking the scoreboard and a twenty-person blitz are T3-006 (reader A); how to place and the direct link are directions (T3-070, all three placements).

Newcomers are told what r/place is and that 'the paint bar should be at the bottom of your screen', T3-016's 'how to pick a colour and place' (reader A and my B1, the larger part); the princess's coordinates and where the start is are directions (T3-070); 'how can I help exactly?' and 'where is she?' ask for them (T3-034), as reader B has both (conflict CC-011).

'/r/Homestuck is still awake, but /r/thailand is not' names the neighbours (T3-052, my B1); 'wtf is happening here?' asks about the event (T3-016, reader B). Reader A's T3-141 needs a watch kept while members sleep.

Choosing and correcting where the banner goes leads (T3-020, reader A and my B1). Holding construction while asking r/GreenLattice, who hold the space, 'you didn't get permission from them' (T3-035), scooting the i and shrinking the U (T3-004, reader A), and pooling effort in one place and abandoning two sites (T3-069) each have three concepts of their own: four themes, more than three placements carry.

Where the Purdue mark goes (T3-020) and the starting square and colour plans (T3-070) hold five concepts each, as both readers have them; two of three placements put T3-020 first. Turning a Michigan banner and RURURU into PURDUE alters others' marks into the room's own sign (T3-068, named by neither reader).

The first heart is destroyed and rebuilt at new coordinates (T3-022, both readers); a semi-transparent reference shows where it goes (T3-070, reader B); r/seolhyun asks this room 'we really need your help', another room asking (T3-084, my B1), which reader B placed as T3-002. One concept each.

Coordinates for Spurdo and 'BEN ... sinne vaan jatkamaan' send people to continue the work (T3-070, reader A and my B1); pointing out where the Finnish flags stand beside Argentina's is T3-026's 'others pointed to where it is' (reader B). Two concepts each.

A script to move the T, taught and updated, leads (T3-028, both readers); agreeing one plan and asking for the official template, with placers who move two pixels corrected (T3-091, reader A and my B1; conflict CC-012); shifting, squaring and shortening the T is the design argued (T3-004, named by neither reader).

Choosing where the Foundation logo goes, '145, 705 is available! Go team!' (T3-020, my B1), the blueprints and direct links (T3-070, reader B) and proposals of the SCP logo, AWCY or a memetic hazard (T3-033, reader A) hold five or more concepts each. Asking, calling and building have two each, so the item is not the bag both readers flagged.

'I don't see it at those coordinates. Is it by the Achievement Hunter logo somewhere?' asks where the work is (T3-034), as both readers have it. My B1 T3-070 rests on one concept naming where a member is trying.
'Where are the Pens on r/place?' asks for directions and is answered (T3-034), as both readers have it. My B1 T3-070 and T3-150 rest on one outsider's suggestion and report of mutual defence.

Asking which pixels fix rather than waste the leaf is a request for directions (T3-034, both readers); 'When will r/place close?' asks about the event itself (T3-016, reader A and my B1). One concept each.
